help.stdout:
Usage: node commons/test/desk-302-browser.mjs [options]

  --url URL       Absolute /desk URL on the running PR #302 server
                  (default: http://127.0.0.1:3000/desk; env: DESK_302_URL)
  --out DIR      Directory for two PNGs and results.json
                  (default: teams/build/outputs/desk-302-browser; env: DESK_302_OUT)
  --browser PATH Chromium/Chrome executable (env: CHROME_PATH or CHROMIUM_PATH)

The target server must already expose populated composer, hand-in and review states.
No session cookie is accepted or installed. Missing required states fail rather than
producing a false green. Nothing is submitted and no product code is changed.
